windows.method: Exported Windows Playtest embedded PCK. Ordinary shipped roguelite run via documented launch shortcut, shipped console native input and its existing exec .lcs command batches, native OS-window captures. Normal Enter picks clear loot offers and shipped F5 photo mode hides HUD overlays for final captures. No runtime inspection bridge. Existing Playtest camera replay. Isolated existing Playtest tuning delays zero-viewer game-over to 600 seconds for inspection; all other tuning defaults retained. Batches of 16 ordinary rival spawn requests exercise randomized operator bodies. Frame profiling enabled solely to prove selected native aim asset paths, not to measure cost.
windows.captureScope: The two wide Windows images show unobscured ordinary native gameplay; they do not independently identify both marksman variants or prove individual poses. The native active-asset log verifies both A/B runtime aim paths. Detailed A/B body, hand and sprint visuals are the separate independently audited 5 m fixture captures bound to the exact source bodies.
